purpose: label-free complete deployed-proposal endpoint and token coverage audit

inputs.video_selection: all 69 fit-train105 identities whose dataset prefix is 6bba

proposal_pool.baseline: exact c0p25 legacy division-off selected graph
proposal_pool.challengers: every non-selected sparse candidate conflicting with at least one selected adjacent edge

trackastra_window.placement: source frame minus one through source frame plus two, shifted only at video boundaries
trackastra_window.required_nodes: union of every geometry-admissible challenger and incumbent endpoint in one transition
trackastra_window.context_fill: nearest remaining window detections to the required-node coordinate centroid, then time and node_id
trackastra_window.inference_calls: one forward pass per nonempty transition
trackastra_window.score_coverage: every challenger and every incumbent pair must be indexable in its transition association matrix

gate.pass_effect: authorizes preregistration and implementation of a fit-only grouped-OOF frozen-head candidate
gate.fail_effect: redesign window packing or PARK the released zero-wrfeat route before fitting
